## Checklist

- [ ] Tests or a manual check show the change works.
- [ ] Every commit author has accepted the OpenCTEM [Contributor License Agreement](https://docs.openctem.io/legal/cla/) (the `cla` check tells you how), or is a maintainer.

## Extension point?

Delete this section when the change adds or changes no extension point (api/pkg/extension, web/src/lib/extension, a behaviour seam or a grant).

- [ ] The point is named by function, has a Community default that keeps today's behaviour, and a named first user.
- [ ] It is covered by the example extension and a contract test, and the API golden file is updated.
- [ ] Nothing is gated by plan, tier, edition or brand name; a grant only adds, and sign-in, SSO, MFA, audit and security controls are never grants.
- [ ] Docs updated (api/docs/development/editions.md).
